name: A2A Cosmetics — Auditor Port
description: Agent-to-Agent (A2A) + Model Context Protocol (MCP) hub for cosmetics.
brief: AI agents for brands, manufacturers, retailers and distributors. Business to business.
notice: Artificial intelligence makes mistakes. A2A Cosmetics is an information source, not a recommendation. Rules differ by jurisdiction — refer to the regulator in your jurisdiction for the information that applies to you.

supportedInterfaces.description: A2A endpoint — message/send, tasks/get; DataPart {skill, params} runs the gate chain then the tool; text gets the skill list

credential.description: client-credentials Bearer from https://a2a-registry.ai (register at /oauth/register); reads need no authentication; none returns DENY_UNLICENSED_AGENT on the transacting skills

skills.name: list agents
skills.description: Every live agent from the agent table at request time: hostname, role, tenant, region, card URL, signature kid and registration id.

skills.name: get pack index
skills.description: The public index of review packs: number, sealed date, pack hash, file count.

skills.name: get pack
skills.description: One review pack: its signed manifest (SHA-256 per file, pack hash) and, with file given, the file's contents. Auditor bearer.

skills.name: verify receipt
skills.description: Resolve a settlement receipt by nonce from the payments door and verify its EdDSA signature against the receipt keyring.

skills.name: get rule set versions
skills.description: Rule sets in force per jurisdiction (read from the door's health at request time) and every version on the record (from the sealed pack's protocol reading).

skills.name: get azure posture
skills.description: The ENABLED controls of the Azure estate as read from the control plane into the latest sealed pack (azure.json); nothing listed that is not on.

skills.name: get audit log
skills.description: The audit log: one line per auditor call (client id, skill or tool, outcome) for a UTC day. Auditor bearer.
